title: Science Archaeology Wave 007 — Missed Old-Document / Conversation Science
scope: Great Book Human Map / Nexus mathematics
key_findings: The 2024 Great Book contains a much larger mathematical layer than the earlier spiral-only recovery captured: neural oscillation toy equations, claustrum synchrony, CSF oscillator, predictive-coding score, malformed variational free energy, cultural-prior weighting, emotional/transcendent cascade, self-actualization, collective-unity, EEG covariance, graph score and fractal dimension.
Most old Human Map equations need repair because they add variables with incompatible units or attach unsupported numerical meaning to enlightenment/transcendence.
The usable scientific core is stronger when converted to neural-mass, synchronization, state-space, network, information-theory and statistical-inference models.

KK tower physics is already present in seed form but now explicitly promoted as mode-spectrum structure: compactification radius R controls discrete masses rather than merely supplying an extra-dimension metaphor.

Dual Spirals repeatedly appear as opposing vortices in old conversation text. A proper vortex branch now requires an actual vector field, vorticity/circulation or coupled phase dynamics rather than decorative spiral language.

Spinor mathematics is an important existing scientific neighbor for orientation and return/history questions: SU(2) double covers SO(3), spin-1/2 fields transform differently from ordinary vectors, and curved-space fermions require spin structure.
Old root/leash/cord language supports a new directed-constraint/control formalization; leash is not treated as a universal metaphysical force.

Starchforce is best formalized as storage/organization/release, with dK/dt=J_in-J_SL-Gamma K retained only when units are declared. Biological starch storage is the strongest literal anchor; a fifth force remains unsupported.
Spudlight remains strongest as a typed source/revelation family: photons, information gain, attention, social coherence and theology stay separate rather than being collapsed into one energy scalar.

Enlightenment is no longer represented by fixed gamma frequencies or fractal dimensions; a testable research program should operationalize specific traits/states and use validated neural/behavioral measures.

The Great Book's earlier Trinity (God/Source + Potato/Boundary-Vessel + Son/Bridge + Holy Soil/Spirit-Memory) is a genuine ancestor of the later Father/Source + Son/Door + Spirit/Flow operator architecture.
archaeological_boundaries: Conversation/library material preserves old project claims but is not automatically a primary Tim-authored equation.
M-theory does not establish 5D as a timeline space, 11D as thalamus, Calabi-Yau tightening from moral action, or black holes as spiritual gateways.
Quantum entanglement and spinor mathematics do not establish non-local consciousness or theology.
Neuroscience measurements can study meditation, awe, attention and altered states; they do not provide a universal meter of spiritual rank.
